obligations.requirement: Targeted control admission and coherent state
obligations.acceptance: Stale/closed/reattached/read-only target rejected with no owner mutation; apply rechecks identity; two views and clients isolated; duplicate Undo executes at most once; bounded queue and receipts; source-driven state refresh.
Ink/Select/Eraser/Pan affect the actual next input route through common owner; busy switches are atomic and side-effect free; no canonical operation from tool choice.
Missing/invalid/resource-incomplete preset leaves whole old state; valid preset is resolved once with preserved explicit overrides and truthful profile/revision.

Same input/seed with size 4/12, red/blue, opacity 1/0.25 changes expected geometry/paint and captured snapshot; opacity zero valid; old sessions unchanged; eraser diameter is logical-space at DPR 1/2.

Zoom 0.5/1/2 and anchored zoom obey accepted policy; full ObjectId and WorldRect used; empty selection preserves camera; two-view resize/rebind and overlay coherent; canonical/shared Scene content unchanged.

obligations.requirement: UI feedback, history and platform routing
obligations.acceptance: Actual UI submits through common binding, shows owner outcomes and canUndo/canRedo; busy/error rollback truthful; UI capture prevents stray ink; equivalent control-path automated traces across binding adapters.

Generated actual commit/dirty/platform/version or explicit unknown; experimental-off ordinary controls work; all seven mandatory rows and platform bundle identities reported without declaring unobserved physical PASS.

numeric_oracle.raster: assert captured per-session paint and representative color/coverage; do not impose cross-GPU byte-identical screenshots

physical_policy.rule: Build and model tests never prove real physical UI PASS.
